rules.luneStainElementPolicy: melee (BaseDamageType) only; Physical/Void keep element-neutral stainless effects

archetypes.name: Sustained Damage
archetypes.desc: Flat damage that builds over the fight: full Health, no-damage streaks, successive hits, revival, affinity bypass.

archetypes.name: Base Attack
archetypes.desc: Everything that improves, repeats or triggers off the basic attack.

archetypes.name: Skill Damage
archetypes.desc: Skill multipliers, per-hit scaling, element conversions and Stain-consuming skill payoffs.

archetypes.name: Critical
archetypes.desc: Crit chance, crit damage and everything that triggers on or after a Critical hit.
